subject: Preferred invoice ingest route + field mapping questions
messages:

Subject: Redwood - invoice submission method and sample fields

Hi Neha,

Hope you're well — we're completing vendor setup for Redwood in our AP system and wanted to confirm two things before we push you live:

1) Preferred invoice ingest method: do you want us to upload invoices into our supplier portal (recommended for high volume) or continue sending invoices to invoices@redwood.ai via email?

2) We have a required field layout on our portal (PO number, line-item SKU, net amount, tax, remit instructions). Could you share your preferred invoice template or a sample so we can validate mapping?

Attached is an example invoice we received from another vendor for reference.

Thanks — can you loop the right person on Redwood's side if that's not you?

Best,
Samantha Lee
Accounts Payable Lead
Acme Logistics

Subject: Re: Redwood - invoice submission method and sample fields

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear note. Short answers: portal is preferred; email accepted as fallback with a strict template. Details below.

Portal vs email
- Preferred: Supplier portal upload to reduce processing time and avoid manual entry.
- Fallback: invoices@redwood.ai for occasional exceptions (we ask vendors to subject invoices with PO# when emailing).

Template / required fields
- We attached our AP template (Redwood_AP_invoice_template_v3.xlsx). Key fields that must map: PO Number, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Line Description, Line Quantity, Unit Price, Line Total, Tax Amount (per-line or total), Currency, Remit To (bank details).
- If your portal requires SKU fields, the mapping for us is the "Line Description" field (we do not currently publish SKUs publicly).

Next steps
- Samantha: if you can confirm the portal field names, Karthik will verify the mapping on our side and Marissa will validate the template against Redwood's GL codes.
- I copied our AP and procurement owners.

Thanks — attaching the template.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Neha / team,

Thanks for the template. Quick follow-ups from our portal team:
- The portal enforces an explicit "Vendor Remit Name" and separate "Bank Account" fields. Can you confirm if Redwood prefers wire details or ACH?
- For PO-less invoices (one-off services), what subject line should our team use if emailing to invoices@redwood.ai to ensure auto-routing?

Tom

Date: 2026-02-12T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - invoice submission method and sample fields

Hi Tom / Samantha — looping in Redwood AP (Michael) to confirm bank/remit and Marissa for GL mapping. Answers inline below.

- Remit instructions: Redwood prefers ACH (USD) for US vendors. Wire accepted for international vendors — bank details are on the template under the Remit To section. Please populate the portal "Bank Account" and "Vendor Remit Name" fields with the values from our template.

- PO-less invoices: when emailing, please use subject line: "NoPO - VendorName - Invoice# - InvoiceDate". That triggers our exception workflow and routes to manual AP review.

- SKU / GL / tax breakdown: Marissa will take the SKUs and produce a small mapping table back to you. If a SKU field is mandatory in the portal, populate with the line description. For tax, our template accepts both per-line tax and total tax — we will prioritize per-line when provided.

Michael, can you confirm SLA for manual PO-less invoice processing so Acme has expectations?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@acme-logistics.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-logistics.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-13T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - invoice submission method and sample fields

Hi all — quick operational confirmation:

1) Ingest route: portal is the default and will be enabled for Acme (we sent the onboarding invite this morning). For low-volume exceptions, Acme may email invoices@redwood.ai but must follow the subject-line convention above.

2) SLA: PO'd invoices processed T+10 business days after receipt; PO-less/exception invoices T+15 business days. If an invoice is missing required fields, we'll open a vendor query and hold payment until resolution.

3) Attachments / naming: When emailing, please attach PDFs (not images), include the PO number in the filename when available (e.g., PO12345_Invoice6789.pdf).

Marissa — once you share the GL mapping, we will pass the sample back to Acme for final portal field acceptance.

Thanks everyone — welcome aboard.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Head of Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
